scopeNotes: This is an internal service/repository slice. It intentionally exposes no server function, UI, MCP tool, scheduler or caller-supplied authorization boundary.
Change Event facts and URL children expose no ordinary update/delete methods. Action links are append-only associations and expose no unlink method.
The shared exact-URL normalizer preserves existing Recommendation/Action behavior while adding a deterministic multi-URL wrapper for Change Events.
Measurement anchors, corrections/voiding, site-wide scope, external source adapters and public surfaces remain deferred.
